verdict.rationale: Elastic documents user-defined alerting rules that evaluate conditions in the background and fire notifications, and it claims an AI SRE ('nightshift') that detects and investigates incidents on its own. Together these show product-native background automation with some agentic investigation, but the evidence for configuring autonomous AI workflows is a single marketing line. missing for 10: documented user-configurable agentic workflows, details on how the AI SRE is triggered or scheduled, autonomous remediation actions beyond notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
You can create a rule to send an alert when the log aggregation exceeds a threshold.
You can also extend your alerts with notifications via services or third-party incident management systems.
